title: Design exercise: SAA-2.2-S07
scenario: Dunmore Textile Mills schedules its looms with a vendor application that has no source available and runs on two physical servers in the mill's server room; rebuilding after losing both would take about two days. The business now wants the scheduler running again within 1 hour of such a loss with no more than a few seconds of data loss, and the vendor will not change anything. The application's data lives in an RDS for MySQL database reached over the mill's existing private network link. At month-end its 250 concurrent users each open new database connections and it fails with connection-limit errors, and a database failover currently forces a full application restart. The only setting operators can change is the database hostname.
constraints: Do not claim live AWS experience
No change to the application code or binaries is possible
Operators can change only the database hostname setting
The mill will not buy new server hardware

rubric.label: The 1-hour recovery target and the few-seconds data-loss target are met with no application change
Connection-limit errors at 250 users and the restart after a database failover are addressed by changing only the hostname

constraint_reason: Mapped as design_exercise to complete skill coverage when no dedicated live lab step exists
